messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.

- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.

- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2025-02-27] standup/cinder/2025-02-27: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.
- [2025-06-06] standup/cinder/2025-06-06: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-09-16] handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder today; Oskar Lind wrote up the handover doc for Diego.
- [2025-09-05] standup/cinder/2025-09-05: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-30] standup/cinder/2025-01-30: If the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down: it relies on it for product documents.
- [2025-06-27] standup/cinder/2025-06-27: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-04-22] standup/cinder/2025-04-22: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.
- [2025-12-29] standup/cinder/2025-12-29: Reminder: auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-04-17] standup/cinder/2025-04-17: Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.

Question: Which services does Cinder own now?

message.content: The ledger, the job scheduler, and the auth gateway.
message.reasoning:
The question asks: which services does Cinder own now (today is 2026-06-30)?

Let me trace ownership changes over time for services.

Services mentioned:
1. Product catalog: Cinder owns it (2025-01-17). But 2025-12-19: Atlas taking over product catalog from Cinder effective today. So now Atlas owns catalog, not Cinder.

2. Indexer: owned by Cinder (2025-01-17). But 2025-05-20: Atlas taking over search-indexer from Cinder, effective today. So not Cinder now.

3. Notification service: 2025-06-11 says Cinder, but 2025-06-27 correction says it went to Dune team, not Cinder. So Cinder never owned it.

4. Ledger pager: 2025-10-13: pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not Atlas. Ownership transferred. So Cinder owns ledger (pager ownership). Still? No later change. So Cinder owns ledger now.

5. Job scheduler: 2025-09-23: pager for job scheduler rings Cinder, not Dune. Ownership transferred. So Cinder owns job scheduler now.

6. Auth gateway: 2025-09-16: Ember handed the authentication gateway to Cinder. No later transfer away. So Cinder owns auth gateway now.

7. Billing-api: 2025-03-07: new home Ember team. Not Cinder. (2026-03-11: Cinder noticed billing-api issue and pinged owners — consistent Cinder doesn't own it.)

8. Image resizer: 2025-03-20: now with team Ember. Not Cinder.

9. Reporting service: Ember still owns. Not Cinder.

So services Cinder owns now: ledger, job scheduler, auth gateway.

Answer in one short line: ledger, job scheduler, auth gateway.
